python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import os
os.chdir('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')
p='src/codegen_support/runtime/io/zlib_filter_flush.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old='''    emitter.instruction("mov rdi, QWORD PTR [rbp - 8]");                        // fd = the saved file descriptor
    abi::emit_symbol_address(emitter, "rsi", "_stream_filter_buf");
    emitter.instruction("mov edx, r11d");                                       // produced byte count as the write length
    emitter.syscall(4);'''
new='''    emitter.instruction("mov rdi, QWORD PTR [rbp - 8]");                        // fd = the saved file descriptor
    abi::emit_symbol_address(emitter, "rsi", "_stream_filter_buf");
    emitter.instruction("mov edx, r11d");                                       // produced byte count as the write length
    // libc `write`, not a raw syscall: this target has no syscall emission, and the filter shape
    // this pass belongs to writes the same way.
    emitter.bl_c("write");'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('x86 uses libc write')
